notes: 74HCS165: SCHMITT-TRIGGER INPUTS, NOT A PLAIN 74HC165. Every key input crosses its thresholds at the key network's RC rate, far slower than a plain HC165 allows; the HCS165 has no input transition-rate requirement (datasheets/logic/SN74HCS165-ti-scls828a.pdf p.15) and the same pinout and SOIC-16 (p.3). Thresholds at 3.3 V: TI publishes rows at 2, 4.5 and 6 V only, so key-release-time and key-press-time are taken at its extreme ratios (their threshold_note). HC-FAMILY OUTPUTS, NOT LVC: over an unterminated line faster edges are what cause reflections, and the HCS165's (output transition at most 5 ns at 4.5 V and 25 C, 8 ns over temperature, p.8) keep each hop - a ribbon and part of the main board - an ordinary lumped load; LVC with source termination is the way back if E4 disagrees. ONE PER CLUSTER: right_thumb and left_thumb on the main board, right_hand and left_hand on the key boards (ADR 0017). Tie CLK INH low at all four. A board house substitute must have Schmitt-trigger inputs with no transition-rate limit: a 74HC165 or a 74LV165A (whose Schmitt action still carries a rate limit, datasheets/logic/74LV165A-nexperia.pdf p.5) is not one. The bought part is the sheet's (ADR 0019)
